people.name: Judas
people.line: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus

translations.web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
translations.bsb: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”
translations.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
translations.asv: Judas (not Iscariot) saith unto him, Lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
